title: Xtra Power Herbal Body Massage Oil for Men, 50ml | Ayurvedic Blend with Ashwagandha, Shilajit, Safed Musli, Gokshura, Kaunch Beej & Macroot | Nourishing Massage Oil for External Use | Non-Greasy Daily Body Care
description: 🌿 Xtra Power Herbal Body Massage Oil is a premium Ayurvedic-inspired body massage oil formulated with a carefully selected blend of traditional herbal ingredients including Ashwagandha, Shilajit, Safed Musli, Gokshura, Kaunch Beej, and Macroot. Designed exclusively for external use, this herbal massage oil is suitable for daily body care and massage routines. 💆 The lightweight and non-sticky formula spreads smoothly across the skin, allowing for a comfortable massage experience. It absorbs easily without leaving an oily residue, making it suitable for regular use at home, after exercise, or as part of a personal wellness routine. 🌱 Enriched with botanical extracts, the oil helps moisturize and nourish the skin while providing a soothing massage experience. Regular massage can help keep the skin feeling soft, smooth, and refreshed. ✨ The convenient spray bottle delivers controlled application, helping minimize product wastage while ensuring hygienic use. Its compact 50ml size is ideal for travel, gym bags, and everyday storage. 🧴 To use, spray a small amount onto clean, dry skin and massage gently until absorbed. For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes, broken skin, or sensitive areas. Discontinue use if irritation occurs. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and keep out of reach of children. Xtra Power Herbal Body Massage Oil is manufactured using quality ingredients and packaged in a durable spray bottle, making it a practical choice for daily massage and body care
